items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Chauncey Morehouse does not speak in the provided transcript; the mention of Bill Charles is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: He got in there. Jean acquired this position with the Detroit Athletic Club in Detroit. And then he left there. It seemed there was some correspondence between my father and Jean and my brother Charles. And Jean was the one who told my brother Charlie and my father about the Greystone Ballroom building which was actually a Chinese Restaurant, I think it was originally. And this building was available at a very good price.
Was he looking for a place?
